design.label: Brand lavender
design.decision: comparison candidate; border policy not selected

referenceProvenance.identity: The OG blue Yunidragon: a slender upright long-necked baby dragon, large amber-brown eyes, a broad cyan forehead crest with blue spots, blue cheek and dorsal surfaces with light mint-cyan underbelly, coral-red layered ear fins, four short clawed legs, a long tapering tail, and the recognizable OG facial features. Preserve these distinctive markings and body proportions; do not turn it into a stocky winged dragon or another animal.

backgroundModifier: meadow-blue: preserve rolling green hills, a clear azure sky, soft clouds and the distant windmill

prompts.revision:
Edit the attached finished YUNIPALS trading card into a corrected brand-study candidate.
Output one 1024 x 1536 PNG, portrait 2:3, transparent exterior.
Image #1 is the exact source card. Preserve this OG Blue Yunidragon's
face, anatomy, colors, markings, pose, full body, meadow, windmill and composition.
Image #2 is the OFFICIAL Yunipals logo downloaded from https://www.yunipals.com/.

HORN CORRECTION: Replace the ivory forehead horn with the OG normal SPIRAL horn: a naturally tapered, refined golden horn, warm honey-gold with antique bronze shadows and soft golden-beige highlights, distinct spiraling grooves. It must read as GOLD, not white, ivory, marshmallow or an exaggerated soft-serve cone. Keep its forehead attachment and the monster's face intact.

FRAME COMPARISON — Brand lavender:
Change the outer frame's dominant material color to #c7c9f9.
Use a soft polished LAVENDER frame matching the Yunipals website CI, with grape-purple recessed edge detail.
Replace the previous gold frame, gold nameplate rims and gold lettering. Gold is
reserved for a Spiral horn; the frame must visibly read as the requested color.
Use thin grape-purple #7e22ce inner pinstripes and a restrained purple-to-cyan accent.
Keep a premium clean rounded collectible-card silhouette with an intact border.

OFFICIAL BRANDING:
Replace the old 3D beige dragon medallion with the EXACT supplied official flat logo:
dark outlined pale-gold dragon head, green eye, mint fins, hot-pink circle, white sparkles.
Keep the logo a faithful flat graphic, not a newly illustrated 3D dragon. Keep its
pink badge visible and recognizable, placed cleanly in the top-left header area.
Use a pale frosted-glass white/lavender header and matching bottom nameplate.
Exact header text YUNIPALS in chunky Archivo Black-style sans-serif, grape #7e22ce.
Exact bottom name YUNIDRAGON, same grape-purple brand typography.
These are the only words. No level, stats, badge text or added labels.

FINISH:
Retain clearly visible glitter embedded in the monster BODY and holographic rainbow foil OVER the card ART. Keep the original face and color readable; leave the new frame, logo and text crisp.
Keep transparent margins around all four sides, rounded corners, no exterior halo,
no drop shadow, no canvas-edge pixels. Preserve the source card's character identity.

visualReview.note: Inspected full card and white/black/checkerboard composites. Transparent outer edges are clean. Spiral horns are warm gold; diamond horns remain clear crystal. Official flat logo and purple CI text are visible. Glitter variants retain body sparkle and holographic card treatment. Frame color remains a design comparison pending user review.
